title: Public page: restyle the site in the black-and-red samurai theme of the README banner
summary: The public website now takes the black-and-red samurai look of the README banner: the drawing full width in the Home page hero, a self-hosted brush font, a recoloured hero animation and a samurai colour scheme on the docs pages. Words, pages, links and screenshots are unchanged.
lessons_learned: No Ruby on this computer, so the Jekyll site cannot be built locally: preview a website change by downloading the github-pages artifact of the pull request's Build site job, serving it under /maestro/ and looking at it in headless Edge. A custom just-the-docs colour variable also needs a default in _sass/custom/setup.scss, because the theme compiles its built-in light and dark sheets too.
